site_settings.biography:
Dr. Hamis Miraji Ally Simba is an applied economist, researcher, and policy consultant specializing in macroeconomic analysis, econometrics, and empirical policy evaluation. His academic and advisory work focuses on the intersection of institutional governance, energy transition, economic modeling, and income distribution dynamics across Sub-Saharan Africa and Tanzania.

He has conducted research at international and domestic academic and policy institutions, including Istanbul Gelisim University, Ankara Yildirim Beyazit University, and the Economic and Social Research Foundation (ESRF). His professional track record includes leadership in bilateral trade facilitation as Economic Director for the Tanzania Chamber of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture (TCCIA) in Turkey, as well as founding Magandi Foreign Trade Comp LTD.

Dr. Simba holds a PhD in Economics from Istanbul Gelisim University, an M.S. in Economics from Ankara Yildirim Beyazit University, and a background in Computer Science from the Institute of Finance Management (IFM), combining quantitative empirical rigor with computational analysis for data-grounded economic decision-making.
